title: squad-close cannot close this squad: wants process.md
body:
squad-close cannot close this squad: wants process.md
`squad-close plugin --scope squad-close` (also --dry-run) stops at bin/squad-close line 46: `[[ -f $squad_dir/process.md ]] || "no squad folder at .../squads/plugin"`. This squad is composed: its folder has plugin.pin, process.local.md and project.md but no process.md (only the legacy squad-bk261023 has one). So the check rejects every composed squad; nothing was closed or moved. The same line is in the pinned 0.5.0 runtime, in main's bin/squad-close and on the dev-2 branch.

(a) I add task 06 here: the check accepts process.local.md or plugin.pin as the squad marker, plus a test in tests/test_squad_close.py; Dev, QA whitebox (qa-b stays off), then close. About one more Dev cycle. Note: the fixed squad-close only runs from a pinned runtime after you merge and re-pin; this close would still use the 0.5.0 pin, so the fix needs a one-off run from the repo's bin/squad-close (`bin/squad-close plugin --scope squad-close`) after the Dev branch is merged. I would ask you in chat before any merge.
(b) You close it another way (move the folder to scopes/_done by hand); the fix becomes its own scope.

Nothing else is waiting: E1-E3 answered, no other open items, branch dev-2 (5adfc45..fb2091c) still unmerged.
options: (a) fix it in this scope as task 06 (check accepts process.local.md / plugin.pin), then close; (b) close by hand now, fix as a separate scope
rec: (a): one-line check plus a test, same file (bin/squad-close) and branch I already own
